_source: Our own table: the two lines of the MV Polymer Works, gtceu:polymer_works (docs/eras/mega.md 4.4). Each line is composed from GTM's live recipes by server_scripts/grindless/lib/compose.js: the recipe takes and gives what the whole line takes and gives, with the energy of every stage summed (rule 7) and spent at maxEUt (MV, 128 EU/t).
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/mv/mega_polymer_works.js at every server load. Each entry becomes one gtceu:polymer_works recipe, id grindless:polymer_works/<name>. `stages` are GTM recipe ids read from the loaded pack, `given` is the batch (keys 'i:<item>' or 'f:<fluid>'), `linked` are the intermediates that net to zero; given + linked must equal the number of stages.

Polyethylene: ethanol + sulfuric acid -> ethylene (the diluted sulfuric acid is the byproduct and leaves through the output hatch), ethylene + oxygen -> polyethylene, polyethylene -> plate in the fluid solidifier. 1152 mB of ethanol is exactly 12 plates (1152 mB ethylene = 8 runs of 144 mB = 1728 mB polyethylene = 12 x 144 mB). The plate mold of the solidifier is a catalyst that is never used up and is not part of the recipe.
Rubber: raw rubber + sulfur -> rubber, rubber -> plate in the fluid solidifier. 9 raw rubber dust is one run of the vulcanisation (1296 mB) and exactly 9 plates.
